mapper.select: SELECT orders.order_id FROM orders_normal_orders AS orders LEFT JOIN aftersales AS a ON orders.order_id = a.order_id WHERE orders.order_auto_close_aftersales_time < #{timeSec} AND orders.order_status = 'DONE' AND orders.is_consumption = 0 AND a.aftersales_status NOT IN (2, 3, 4) GROUP BY orders.order_id

SELECT order_id FROM aftersales WHERE aftersales_status = 2
AND order_id IN
#{oid}
GROUP BY order_id

SELECT order_id AS orderId, SUM(refunded_fee) AS sumRefundedFee FROM aftersales_refund WHERE pay_type <> 'point' AND refund_status = 'SUCCESS'
AND order_id IN
#{oid}
GROUP BY order_id
